प्रफर्वी Ved. A woman having
excellent hips or going in a graceful
way; a lewd girl (?).

प्रफुल्त p. p. Blooming,
bloossomed, full-blown; लोध्रद्रुमं सानुमतः प्र
फुल्तं

प्रफुल्ल p. p.
1 Full-blown,
blossoming, blooming; न हि प्रफुल्लं सहकारमेत्य
वृक्षांतरं काक्षति षट्पदाली

; 7. 11.
--2
Expanded or dilated like a full-blown
flower (as eyes).
--3 Smiling.
--4
Shining.
--5 Gay, cheerful, pleased.
--Comp.
--नयन, --नेत्र, --लोचन a. with
eyes expanded with joy.
--वदन a.
having a beaming or cheerful
countenance, looking cheerful.
